Observability._comment_ServiceName: traceId/spanId/service/level/orderId are the mandatory fields on every log entry (observability-standards.md). Order is one of the platform's 100%-trace-coverage services (kart-conventions.md names kart-order-service explicitly, as the Saga orchestrator) - Program.cs sets an AlwaysOnSampler explicitly rather than relying on the SDK default.

Otlp._comment_Endpoint: OpenTelemetry Collector OTLP/gRPC endpoint. Services never ship traces/logs to Tempo/Loki directly (observability-standards.md).

GlobalConfig._comment_Path: Absolute path to a JSON file, outside the repo and never committed, holding this environment's actual ConnectionStrings:OrderDatabase/Mongo:ConnectionString/Mongo:Database/RabbitMq credentials/Identity:JwksUri values (kart-conventions.md Configuration Management). Program.cs layers it on top of this file at startup and fails fast if the path is unset or missing. Local dev sets the concrete path in the gitignored appsettings.Local.json (see appsettings.Local.json.example); a deployed environment supplies it via the GlobalConfig__Path env var pointing at a mounted secret file.

ConnectionStrings._comment_OrderDatabase: Write-side PostgreSQL - source of truth for Order/OrderLineItem/OrderEvent (database-design.md). Secret - supplied via the GlobalConfig file locally, or the ConnectionStrings__OrderDatabase env var / K8s Secret in production, never committed.

Mongo._comment_ConnectionString: Read-side MongoDB - the CQRS query side GET /v1/orders/{id} serves from (database-design.md's Read Model section). Secret - supplied via the GlobalConfig file locally, or env vars / K8s Secret in production, never committed.

Inventory._comment_BaseUrl: kart-inventory-service's base URL for the synchronous POST /inventory/reserve and POST /inventory/release calls (architecture.md). Portless container-DNS default (Docker/kart-devops); overridden to kart-inventory-service's own local dev port in appsettings.Development.json for a bare-metal `dotnet run`.
Inventory._comment_ClientCredentials: Inventory & Stock Management flow fix (2026-08-12): Order's own client-credentials, scope inventory-reserve, used to authenticate the reserve/release calls against Inventory's OrderServicePolicy - previously this client attached no bearer token at all (every real call 401'd, see contracts note). Secret - supplied via the GlobalConfig file locally, or env vars / K8s Secret in production, never committed.

Payment._comment_BaseUrl: kart-payment-service's base URL for the synchronous POST /payments/{id}/refund compensation call (architecture.md's Compensation-Refund Trigger). Portless container-DNS default (Docker/kart-devops); overridden to kart-payment-service's own local dev port in appsettings.Development.json for a bare-metal `dotnet run`.
Payment._comment_ClientCredentials: Order's own orderServicePrincipal client-credentials (scope payment-compensation) used to authenticate the refund call. Secret - supplied via the GlobalConfig file locally, or env vars / K8s Secret in production, never committed.
